description: Generic review rubric for app-content cards that don't have a specialized rubric (misconception, dpp_blueprint, grading_rubric, revision_card).

criteria.label: Content accuracy
criteria.description: All factual / mathematical / scientific claims correct.

criteria.label: Purpose fit
criteria.description: Card actually does what its card_type promises (a misconception card surfaces a misconception; a revision card supports recall; a rubric scaffolds grading).

criteria.label: Clarity
criteria.description: Title accurately describes body. Body is scannable. No filler text.

criteria.label: Completeness
criteria.description: Card stands alone. Student understands without needing to also pull up 3 other cards.

criteria.label: Level appropriateness
criteria.description: Right depth for Class 11/12. Not condescending, not over the head.
